name: Navitia
tagline: Multimodal public-transport journey planner with open data and free developer access
description: Navitia is a multimodal trip-planning API covering public transit, bike, walking, and car. Developers query coverage regions, stop areas, schedules, and door-to-door journeys. Authentication uses a self-serve API key; free tiers and paid plans are documented on the vendor site.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic auth (key as username, empty password) or Authorization header; self-serve signup at navitia.io

use_cases: plan multimodal transit journeys between two points
list transit coverage regions and networks
get next departures at a stop area
geocode places near transit for routing
